thread:
Sofia: Heads up — noticed ~120 inbound leads in 'unassigned' over the last 6h. Looks like enrichment webhook to our enrichment service timed out and HubSpot workflow didn't fall back to round-robin. HubSpot shows 'waiting_on_external' state.
Ethan: yep saw spikes around 03:10 UTC. Enrichment lambda was throttled. HubSpot workflow has a 1-hour wait step before owner assignment — that's too long.
Sofia: SLA for handoff should be <= 10m. Marketing ops and Sales need predictable handoffs. Can we set fallback to assign to rotation after 5m?
Priya: I can change workflow but want a safe migration. Suggest: (1) short-term: set fallback owner after 5m; (2) medium: add prefix caching so partial enrichment ok; (3) long: retry/backoff on lambda side.
Ethan: Agreed. Also add a metric: percent of leads assigned within 10m. We'll add to the leads dashboard.
Ben: Quick patch I'm comfortable with: change workflow 'wait_for_enrichment' step -> timeout 300s and add 'assign fallback' action. HubSpot CLI snippet:
```bash
hs workflow update --id 98321 --set 'wait_delay=300' --add-action 'assign:sd-rotation'
```
Priya: runbook note? If fallback triggers, create task 're-enrich' and put lead into 're-enrich queue' tag.
Sofia: +1. Also notify sales-ops channel when >50 fallbacks in 1h. Use webhook -> #sales-ops-alerts.
hubspot-bot: 03:24 UTC — enrichment webhook failures: 43 leads in last hour (status=502)
Ethan: I'll schedule the workflow change now; rolling it for 10 min maintenance window. ETA 10m.
Sofia: Thanks — update Slack when done. After deploy, we'll run a backfill: re-run enrichment for 're-enrich' tagged leads.
Ethan: Done. Workflow updated. Rolling back if any issues.
hubspot-bot: 03:33 UTC — workflow 98321 updated by ethan. No errors.
Sofia: verified ~95% of backlog assigned within 7m. Closing for now, create retro ticket for infra throttling.
Priya: created ticket PROD-4867 with root cause and action items. cc @chris-salesops for SLA docs.
Ethan: will add the 10m SLA to the lead routing playbook and update HubSpot docs.
Sofia: great, thanks all :tada:
